title: Slice out the middle company or companies
description:
Slice out the middle IT company or companies from the list.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as middle_companies(companies), returning a list of the single middle item when companies has an odd length, or the two middle items when it has an even length.
hints: The number of middle items depends on whether the list length is odd or even.
For an odd length, len(companies) // 2 is the single middle index; for an even length, the two middle indices are one before and at that position.
Use companies[mid - 1:mid + 1] when n is even and [companies[mid]] when n is odd, with mid = n // 2.
expected_behavior: Returns a list with the middle item (odd length) or two middle items (even length).
explanation: Odd-length lists have exactly one middle index (n // 2); even-length lists have two middle items straddling the center, found with companies[mid - 1:mid + 1].
